doc_title_en: Notice regarding revisions to FY2027 Q2 interim and full-year earnings forecasts and dividend forecast (dividend increase)
doc_title_jp: 2027年３月期第２四半期（中間期）及び通期業績予想並びに配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 業績が当初計画を上回って推移、財政状態及び今後の見通しを総合的に勘案

summary_en: ¥130/share annual dividend (¥10 increase from prior ¥120 forecast). Interim and full-year earnings upgraded on stronger operating profit, currency tailwinds, and cost improvements. Payout reflects better-than-expected FY3/27 performance.
summary_jp: 通期配当を130円/株に修正（前回120円から10円増配）。営業利益、経常利益、当期純利益の上方修正を反映し、業績連動配当を実施。
tag_en: Dividend increase – ¥130/share (¥10 hike) – FY3/27 full year
